_comment: The config-error path: every shape of rule that cannot decide anything.
This is the negative fixture the suite never had. N08/N09 cover malformed FILES; nothing
covered a well-formed file whose RULES are meaningless, which is the class three separate
defects lived in -- a rule with one unreadable band, a band that can never fire, and a
retired key that silently inverted what the rule meant. All three were judged and reported
PASS, with ERROR findings beside them changing nothing.
Every rule here must be NOT_JUDGED / INVALID_RULE, gate.status must stay clean because none
of them is a verdict, and the run must exit non-zero because the file asked for checks that
never ran. The healthy rule at the end proves the evaluator was reached at all.

assertions.description: fail has two operators; warn survives, so hasBands() stays true
a tolerance of 20 meant as 20% — nothing is negative
meant never gates; ignoring it leaves a rule that gates
meant fail-if-absent; ignoring it turns a red build green
a corridor is two rules now
two target forms — picking one would judge something nobody asked for
proves the evaluator was reached and the others are not collateral
